parts.name: NumberFieldRoot
parts.description: Holds the number field's value and shares it with the parts inside it. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it also renders a hidden `<input type="number">` that holds the plain value for the form.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a number, or `null` for an empty input. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the number field. Or pass it with only `onValueCommitted`: the field then shows each step and what is typed by itself, and shows `value` again as soon as the owner's `onValueCommitted` has run: the owner's guess, or its old value until it writes the new one. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called whenever the value changes: as typed text parses, on each step, while a stepper is held or the scrub area is dragged. Receives the value and details whose `reason` is `input-change`, `input-clear`, `input-blur`, `keyboard`, `increment-press`, `decrement-press`, `wheel` or `scrub`. It is called in a change of its own, after the one that updated the field, so it may write something a loading question reads without holding the field or overwriting what is typed.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when a change is final: on blur after typing; on each key, wheel turn and stepper click; and on release after holding a stepper or scrubbing. Receives the value and the `reason`. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the field is never held by it, and steps on from what it shows while the save is out.

props.name: min
props.description: The smallest value. Steps stop at it, typed values are clamped to it, and Home goes to it. Without it there is no lower bound.

props.name: max
props.description: The largest value. Steps stop at it, typed values are clamped to it, and End goes to it. Without it there is no upper bound.

props.name: step
props.description: How far the arrow keys, the steppers and each scrub step move the value.

props.name: smallStep
props.description: The step taken with Alt held.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The step taken with Shift held.

props.name: snapOnStep
props.description: Round a step to a multiple of `step` from `min` (or from 0).

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description: Let typed values outside `min` and `max` stand. Steps still clamp.

props.name: allowWheelScrub
props.description: Turning the wheel over the input steps the value while the input has focus.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the number field can't be changed or focused. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A field disabled while its input has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) gives focus back to the input when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the value can be focused and read but not changed. `readOnly={pending? setting}` locks the field while a save is out without losing focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a value is needed for the form to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the hidden input submits the value under. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, when the number field isn't inside it.

props.name: format
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options: how the input shows the value and reads what is typed.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale used for formatting and parsing. Defaults to the browser's.

parts.name: NumberFieldInput
parts.description: The text input (`inputmode="numeric"`) that shows the value formatted and reads typed text. Arrow Up and Down step (Shift: large step, Alt: small step), Home and End go to `min` and `max` when set, and blur clamps and formats what was typed. Give it an `id` for a `<label for>`; the steppers' `aria-controls` follow it.

parts.name: NumberFieldScrubArea
parts.description: An area to press and drag to change the value: right (or up, vertically) increases it. A mouse's pointer is locked while it scrubs, and NumberFieldScrubAreaCursor is drawn instead. Put the label inside it.

props.name: direction
props.description: The axis the pointer moves along to scrub.

props.name: pixelSensitivity
props.description: How many pixels of movement make one step.

props.name: teleportDistance
props.description: How far, in pixels, the virtual cursor may go from the area before it wraps to the other side.

dataAttributes.name: data-direction
dataAttributes.description: The scrub axis: `horizontal` or `vertical`.
